responsibility: Declares the RTL-specific diagnostic entry points for reporting errors and warnings associated with asm-containing RTL instructions. It is the small public header that exposes error_for_asm and warning_for_asm on top of the generic diagnostic framework and RTL types.
same_name_distinction: Provides the minimal public declarations for RTL asm diagnostics such as error_for_asm and warning_for_asm; unlike gcc/rtl-error.cc, it does not implement source-location lookup or fatal-insn reporting.
